The most anticipated rock-themed game of 2023 is out now: Be a Rock is on sale!
Go on a spiritual journey with BE A ROCK. Your spirit is born in the form of a rock as you explore canyons, deserts, and volcanic lands in order to uncover secrets of the past. The game features puzzle solving, and a distinct storytelling style. Get the game now!

notes.title: "Close-to-the-Finish" Dev notes #3: The game is finally ready!
notes.content:
"Close-to-the-Finish" Dev notes #3: The game is finally ready!
After a grueling month of crunch time we are finally ready to release Be a Rock. The game is pretty fun to play and we are excited to hear feedback from our fans! Not much else to say right now. See you after the release!

notes.title: "Close-to-the-Finish" Dev notes #2: This game will surprise you
notes.content:
"Close-to-the-Finish" Dev notes #2: This game will surprise you
As we are gearing up to finish Be a Rock, we are really proud of the results that we have achieved. The game definitely started as a simpler project but grew to something bigger, that surprised us and hopefully it will surprise you! Here we want to share a level that is very interesting visually!
Please wishlist the game as it comes out soon!

notes.title: Be A Rock official released date announced: March, 31 2023
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the launch of a new PC game called "BE A ROCK" on Steam, set to release on March 31, 2023.

In this game, players will have the opportunity to take on the role of a rock and experience the world from a unique perspective. As a rock, you'll pass through various environments, from beautiful deserts to tranquil countryside landscapes, while overcoming obstacles and interesting puzzles along the way.

The game features stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, with a soundtrack that is sure to get players grooving. With its unique style, BE A ROCK offers hours of fun and entertainment for gamers of all ages.

Mark your calendars for March 31, 2023, and get ready to BE A ROCK on Steam! Don't miss out on the chance to roll your way through this exciting new game.
